lines.text: Many learners say: I am thinking in you.
Better: I am thinking about you.
About! I am thinking about you.

native.tip: Em português dizemos “pensar em”, mas em inglês usamos “think about”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I am thinking in you.” O certo é “I am thinking about you.” O “em” de “pensar em” leva muita gente a escolher “in”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “about”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “pensar em”, but in English we use “think about”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I am thinking in you.” The right way is “I am thinking about you.” The “em” in “pensar em” makes many learners choose “in”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
